description: This file defines the interface FeaturePropertiesBuilder, a mutable builder for FeatureProperties with a fluent API, including methods for setting, removing, and building feature property objects with various data types and predicates.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesBuilder
classes.description: An interface for a mutable builder that constructs FeatureProperties objects with methods for setting various property types, removing properties, and building the final object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property with a specific data type (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, or JsonFieldDefinition) to the FeatureProperties being built, optionally using a predicate to determine if the property should be set.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields to the FeatureProperties, replacing duplicates and applying a predicate for inclusion.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a property by key or by JsonFieldDefinition from the FeatureProperties being built.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all properties from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a new FeatureProperties object containing all set properties.
